mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, leads to decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to diminished economic growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, directly boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending drives economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances with rising RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high FEDFUNDS (> 4.5%) and low CPIAUCSL (< 200) creates a unique monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with specified FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL conditions, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE (> 0.5% in 1 month), indicating labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors become cautious.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with sharp UNRATE increases, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising HOUST (indicating a strong housing market) and high GDPC1 (> $14T) creates a robust economic growth environment, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with specified HOUST and GDPC1 conditions, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
